rows: 1.30295 at 07:05 → 1.30707 at 09:55 · 41.2 pips up
1.30501 · 15.5 pips below price · returns by noon on 52% of sessions

text: Both pairs dipped a few pips under the Asia low at 07:05 (GBP/USD 1.30295, EUR/USD 1.08965), then climbed about 41 pips through the Asia high into 09:55 (GBP/USD 1.30707, EUR/USD 1.09368). Price sits about 15 pips above the killzone EQ on each (GBP/USD 1.30501, EUR/USD 1.09179); the previous week's low overhead (GBP/USD 1.30757, EUR/USD 1.09537) is still unspent. The pairs agreed, so no SMT.
